title: Sanctions/PEP list chunk v1
description: One chunk of a published sanctions/PEP list snapshot (EDGE_DATA_RESIDENCY_CONTRACT.md section 6.4). GET /api/v1/edge/sanctions/list/{listHash}/chunks/{index}, HSE-1 context 'hokeka.sanctions.list.chunk', signed with the Control Plane Ed25519 key, sealed to the node's X25519 key, inside the channel replay envelope. data is the base64 of the gzip-compressed JSON lines; each line is one sanctions-list-entry. The Edge MUST check listHash, index, sha256 and entryCount against the manifest it holds before storing the chunk.
